thread:
Alex: Quick proposal — unpin runtime v3.2 for the nightly release window (03:00 UTC) to pick up the quant kernel hotfix. Need ops + SDK signoff, and a rollback plan. TL;DR: safe canary, sticky pin for longseq models.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Proposed change: runtime v3.2 -> unpinned at 2024-06-xx 03:00 UTC
Affected shards: eu-west-1, us-east-1
Affected models: llama3q, llama3, redwood-gptx
Canary: 1% traffic -> 10% -> 50% -> full
Commands:
```
deploybot schedule --change runtime:unpin:v3.2 --start 1718238400 --canary 1,10,50
```

Sanjay: what are rollback conditions? any memory regressions reported with the kernel change? :thinking_face:

Maria: SDK note — client-wide shim v1.4.2 is required for the new kernel path. Without it, streaming may drop. Are we pushing that with the change or do we gate on SDK rollout?

ops-jen: +1 for canary but need concrete thresholds. Propose: latency P95 increase > 15% or error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m => abort. Also need a cooldown window between canary steps (10m) and an abort playbook. Do we have a warm cache plan for longseq? 

Alex: rollback criteria accepted. Will add to runbook:
- abort if P95 > +15% for 5m
- abort if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m
- abort on KV-cache miss storm
Canary cadence: 1% -> wait 10m -> 10% -> wait 15m -> 50% -> wait 20m -> full
Warm cache: we'll pre-warm KV cache for the longseq fleet in eu-west with synthetic prefixes.

Nina: we should soft-pin embed models (embed-v2, semantic-llamamm) for 24h post-unpin. Those are sensitive to quant changes.

Alex: good call. We'll add a 24h soft-pin for embed-* and longseq groups. Release notes draft:
"Runtime v3.2 unpin: includes quant kernel hotfix. Requires client shim v1.4.2. Canary rollout with abort thresholds. Soft-pin applied to embed models for 24h."

deploy-bot: ack: scheduled tentative window. To proceed run:
```
deploybot confirm --thread 1718234567 --run-now=false
```

Sanjay: add a line in release notes about rollback process and contact oncall: @ops-oncall, ping if abort.

Alex: Will update release notes and run the confirm after SDK team publishes shim. Targeting 03:00 UTC tonight. Thanks all :thumbsup:
